notes.title: Cartel Tycoon Prosperity Update Announcement & Roadmap Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hola, Capos!

Happy to announce that Prosperity Update with major new content and features will arrive in two weeks, on June 23.[/h2]

Today, we want to tell you more about both our short-term and long-term plans: what we have prepared in store for June 23 and also share more details on how our roadmap has recently evolved (multiplayer and enemy AI are getting more love now!).

Also, you can buy Cartel Tycoon on Steam with a 20% discount right now to prepare for the new update! Tell your friends!

[h2]Prosperity Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/11ce0223bbc7d290e0ce09e331ff239aa7a8fd20.png[/img]


[olist]
[*] Our new buildings bring new exciting ways to fit the style of your Capo and your own playstyle: introducing [b]Paranoid, Party, Pretentious and Modern Residences[/b]. We did not want the difference to be purely cosmetic, so we ended up giving each type of Residence its own unique mechanics. More details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1220140/eventcomments/5296777170369513872?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]in this post[/url] and devlog episode:
[previewyoutube=dW2xserFGgs;full][/previewyoutube]



[*] With the previous update we introduced customized difficulties - this time we are taking it even further and [b]making lots of parameters in Sandbox customizable at the game start[/b]. Want to keep the authorities passive while keeping the challenge of production optimization? Maybe you want to play normally but start with all researches unlocked? Or how about putting everything on the highest difficulty but start with a big load of money to build lots of stuff right away? Now you can do all that, and more, and we cannot wait for you to share to hear your reports on the most fun ways to play Cartel Tycoon with us... and other players! [b]Yes, other players will be able to try out your customized settings![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/4c9d4a9cfbc5139085ce0b11734af49ae3e72de9.png[/img]


[*] And for those who want a pure hardcore permadeath experience, we have added [b]Survival Mode[/b]! No manual saves, a couple of dollars in your pocket, lots of enemies and imminent death on the horizon. Your Capo took a deal he shouldn’t have taken and now you have to use all of your abilities to survive. Take a long walk before starting a game in a Survival Mode and be sure you’re experienced enough to be ready to face the challenges. Or, maybe you just like that sweet-sweet suffering.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/574a40a4f95084e3e940c2b1fcf25955d932d6eb.png[/img]


[*] Last but not least, we’re introducing [b]Global Progression![/b] In this update we’ve added Special Challenges to the Story Mode! If you complete them - you will be able to unlock new starting bosses and regions for Sandbox & Survival Modes! For now, there are 4 unlockable characters in total: would you be able to catch ‘em all? More updates to Global Progression are on the way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/a9fdcbbc09982700b1674c43d73064a206645614.png[/img]
[/olist]


[b]The Prosperity update is being released on June 23.[/b] What happens after it is live? As usual, we will closely watch your reports and great feedback and make sure the major bugs are being fixed right away. But let’s talk about our long-term plans - moving forward to the topic of our...

[h2]Development Roadmap[/h2]

First of all, our Development Roadmap now also [url=https://www.carteltycoon.com/roadmap]lives on our own website[/url], as well as [url=https://trello.com/b/I3Ja70gQ/cartel-tycoon-development-roadmap]in Trello[/url]. Some of you have already noticed that we've made some significant updates to it, so please take a look at the updated version (and as usual, please keep in mind that, like anything else in game development, these plans are subject to change)

After the Prosperity update is released, we want to deliver another two major updates around August and October, and then finally release 1.0, targeting somewhere between Q4 2021 and Q1 2022 for it. It is a few months later than we initially had planned, but hear the good news - [b]we are setting ourselves a goal to ship multiplayer as a part of our 1.0 release!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/13c5708f6b94f8516782ebce27d0ca85ce55cdd3.png[/img]

Going to be challenging, but absolutely worth it; can’t wait to give you all the way to give good ol’ plata o plomo to your Steam friends. 

Another big addition many of you are going to be happy about: [b]advanced AI for enemy gangs[/b] is now officially part of the plan!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/4c1dd92712cb16c47b0ab9021ddc1d472f5ea956.png[/img]

They are going to become like cartels equal to your own: you will be able to communicate with their leaders, make alliances, and of course burn them to the ground to make a space for yourself. This is also a challenging task, but having good AI opponents just goes so well with the possibility of co-op gameplay we are investing in! Won’t disappoint you.

In conclusion, a few words about our [b]August update[/b]: it doesn’t have a name yet and the scope can change depending on your feedback to Prosperity Update, but we can already tell that it is going to be no less than it! [b]Military Base, Guerrillas and other unique buildings[/b] are going to be part of it, as well as the grand finale of our storyline (you’ll like it), and more!

That’s it for today. Hope you enjoyed this peak to our plans - let us know in the comments if you have more questions. Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.

notes.title: Devlog #11 - Residences: New Types
notes.content:
Check out our latest Dev Log below and take a peek at one of the features coming to Cartel Tycoon in the June Update! Show the world how to run an illegal business… in style!

[h3]Devlog #11 - Residences: New Types[/h3]
[previewyoutube=dW2xserFGgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 

The full transcript is available below:[/h3]
Cartel Tycoon is a survival business sim where you play and conquer as a succession of drug lords. The Early Access version is available now on Steam with a limited 20% discount lasting only this weekend - tell your friends about it! We at Moon Moose want our players to rule the world of Cartel Tycoon and truly build their very own 80s drug empires… And we think you should do it in style. Today we’ll talk about one of the major changes that will be introduced in the upcoming update that will be released on June 23.

One of our main goals is making the game more customizable for every player. In the upcoming update, among other things, we will introduce new and exciting ways that will fit the style of your Capo… and [i]your[/i] playstyle. And what’s one of the best ways of showing the world what kind of empire you’re running? [b]Your residence.[/b]

In the June update we will introduce four types of residencies you can build and manage your empire from. Of course, earning them won’t be easy but remember that each type comes with its own benefits for you, your lieutenants and your shady business. Let’s talk about all of them in detail

Do you always feel like somebody's watching you? Then [b]Paranoid Residence[/b] is your pick. State-of-the-art satellites and machine guns will make sure that nobody... unwanted hears or sees you. You can hide there and continue your business in the shadows. Your lieutenants can and should hide with you - their power will increase for a limited amount of time after they leave this residence. Complete the game in the Survival Mode to earn it. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/flcmatbVIRFIPDqvjz/giphy.gif[/img]


If your Capo feels like he’s just on another level of fame - you should pick a [b]Pretentious Residence[/b]. Yes, of course, it comes with giant statues and a fountain. You won’t be able to miss it. And your money won’t just be used for show - upkeep for all the buildings in the radius of your residence will become significantly cheaper. Unlock all regions to get this one.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/GchpGuNW46wddYRyjt/giphy.gif[/img]


Do you feel like you were born in the wrong generation? You should show off your thoughts with a [b]Modern Residence[/b]. Slick design, high windows… It feels like a Hollywood mansion of a very wealthy businessman with a legit business! And modern means fast - all the production in all of the buildings in the radius of the residence will take much less time. Get all the Golden Emblems and it’s yours.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8aerHEA6Zsq9tlRdnP/giphy.gif[/img]


Your terror is at an all-time low and all the residents love you? Why not build a [b]Party Residence[/b]! Ah, the music, the drinks and constant disco. Show everyone that you just love them from the bottom of your glass! The word about you spreads far and wide, making more people want to join your cartel - the number of lieutenants you can recruit will increase by one and their experience will be earned at a faster rate. Unlock all the bosses to get the party started.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ylkkSxFgPNQsurZvf7/giphy.gif[/img]


Of course, Residencies isn’t the only change coming in the June update. We at Moon Moose and tinyBuild always monitor your feedback and suggestions. Stay tuned, Capos, more changes are coming… including a new mode for our most hardcore players. But for now - [b]goodbye and see you on the lands of Cartel Tycoon!
[/b]

Follow us on social media and be sure to join [url=https://discord.com/invite/carteltycoon]the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to stay up to date on all the latest updates and share your thoughts about the game we’re building together!

notes.title: Cartel Tycoon May Update Is Live!
notes.content:
Hola, Capos!

All of your amazing support and feedback has led us to having a month so productive that we have actually started worrying about Cartel Tycoon turning out being too addictive.

...Haha, joking, nothing will stop us! In fact, we have just released a major update - and it has literally added all the features most requested by our community! Specifically:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/fcaf4367ccdf790ff09cb2124727c461ac64cbbc.png[/img]

As you may have noticed, we are making steps towards making Cartel Tycoon approachable for players that are looking for a more relaxed experience while also keeping its hardcore permadeath roots intact. Next update, on the one hand, will expand on this even further, making Sandbox even more customizable...and on the other hand, we cannot wait to present you the Survival mode! with its own unique goals and narrative.

For those who have closely followed [url=https://trello.com/b/I3Ja70gQ/cartel-tycoon-development-roadmap]our Roadmap[/url], we have to point out that May Update turned out to be less in scope than initially planned. Our plans for the overall scope of the game aren’t affected though, and the upcoming June update will be a much bigger one (I wanted to foreshadow the rest of Miguel’s story for you, but the team asked me not to spoil it - let’s respect their decision). 

Soon we will do another post about Cartel Tycoon Roadmap and how it has recently evolved: best news here is that we are setting ourselves a goal to make the Multiplayer a part of our 1.0 release.

Please go ahead and update your game. And more than ever, we’ll need your opinions and reports about how a weekend with updated balance and features of Cartel Tycoon went for you. And now, full patch notes!

notes.title: Devlog #10 - Steam Early Access Update
notes.content:
Check out our latest Dev Log below, which covers the updates and features we've released since our Steam Early Access launch in March.

[h3]Devlog #10 - Steam Early Access Update[/h3]
[previewyoutube=gRFhowik8KI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 

The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

On behalf of the team at Moon Moose and tinyBuild, thank you for all of your support and feedback throughout this first stage of Cartel Tycoon’s Early Access! Four weeks have passed since our Early Access release on March 18, and it was a very busy time for us! During those four weeks, we have released 4 big patches and 4 smaller hotfixes. For this episode of our Devlog, we’ll provide an overview of all major new features we’ve added in those patches!

Managing a cartel should be sufficiently challenging - it is an illegal enterprise, after all - but it should definitely not be tedious. With that in mind, we improved building automation and added new quality of life features to help streamline your empire management.

The first of these features is a new animated UI element that visualizes the logistical connections between your buildings. When enabled, this new feature will draw a color-coded line between the selected building and those within its logistical network - including those outside the building’s radius of influence. This can be helpful to understand at a glance how your empire is connected, and make adjustments where necessary. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8LIJAbB.gif[/img]

We’ve also added features to help streamline the flow of Dirty Money and reduce the frequency with which a player must manually interact with buildings to manage upkeep. These new features include helpful UI elements to highlight areas where Dirty Money is no longer available, as well as the new “Pause” status for buildings that lack the necessary funds for upkeep. When a building is Paused, it will automatically re-enable itself once Dirty Money has been delivered.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6eGlg1P.gif[/img]

In our most recent update, we made a host of improvements to the Building List - including a highly requested feature that allows players to swap building Upkeep between Dirty and Legal Money. This is especially useful when you need to make changes to a large number of buildings at once, or adjust to a sudden shift in available funds.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MpPNz7F.gif[/img]

We’ve also made updates to overall game balance - including highly requested improvements to Terror acquisition and Lieutenant experience gain - and we’ve overhauled a number of UI elements along the command bar at the bottom of the screen. 

All improvements we’ve made thus far were inspired by and improved upon by your feedback. There’s plenty more big and small changes to come, and we will now be slowly shifting our focus from immediate quality of life changes to adding new mechanics and brand new content - including Prisons, new border types, new resources, and much, much more.

For more details on upcoming features and plans, please check out our official development roadmap.

Join the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/carteltycoon]Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to learn more and chat with the development team - and be sure to follow us on social media for all the latest news and updates.

notes.title: Tips and Tricks for Beginner Druglords
notes.content:
Hola!

As a survival business sim, Cartel Tycoon introduces a variety of unique mechanics to the genre. With that in mind, we've put together a series of tips and tricks to help beginner druglords kick-start their empires.

[h2][b][u]Dirty Money vs Legal Money[/u][/b][/h2]
One of the first and most important elements of efficient Cartel management is the strategic use of Dirty and Legal money. Take a gander at the below video for a breakdown of how these funds differ from one another, as well as some simple tricks to manage them both more effectively.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Early Access Version 0.9.0.1239
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes: Cartel Tycoon V 0.9.0.1239[/h2]

Thank you everyone for your incredible feedback! The primary goal of this patch is to fix some of the most annoying bugs while also improving the approachability of Cartel Tycoon for new players by making the early game less punishing.

[h3][b]Updates & Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Hire confirmation dialog
[*] Add “Skip movies” option in Settings (please pick this option if you have Story crashing at the start of new game, this should fix it)
[*] Updated Mayor dialogues
[*] New Chinese font (easier to read)
[/list]
[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] “Truck Supplier” ability now affects all kind of buildings and always gives the fixed count of trucks
[*] Terror does not rise from Residences overflowing with money any more
[*] Lower Raid probability
[*] Increased the required number of terror points for 4th, 5th and 6th stars
[*] Applied some tweaks to Terror and Loyalty
[*] Increased max Residences amount from 7 to 10
[*] Increased Lab’s cash storage (prevent Dirty Money overflow)
[*] Mayor’s “Freeze Star” favor now costs $150k (was $500k) and the freeze continues for 40 days (was 15 days)
[/list]
[h3][b]Visual updates[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the activation and position of some particles
[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Building deconstruction would not protect from attacks and prevent losing control any more
[*] Fixed CONTROL quest soft lock
[*] Return wind sounds on high camera position
[*] Fixed some Deals texts (wrong numbers)
[*] Localization issues
[*] Domination quest does not count city buildings any more
[*] Fixed system menu button layout
[*] Fixed event log entry tooltip markup for all localizations
[*] Rogue lieutenants won’t burn blockaded buildings now
[*] Fix Almagro Torres city conquest dialogs
[/list]
[h3][b]Known issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] On some of the Windows versions (specifically if something has been done with the default Media Player) our animated intro causes the game crash. The temporary workaround is to turn on“Skip movies” in the settings settings.
[*] There is a very small possibility that rogue lieutenant will destroy the city
[*] Aerodrome deconstruction causes its progress bar to roll back.
[*] Some of your crash dumps were not processed yet, we are working on it
[*] Some Nvidia cards cause D3D to crash at start-up (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/forums/g
[*] ame-ready-drivers/13/256280/unreal-engine-is-exiting-due-to-d3d-device-being-l/)The main menu UI is bugged at some laptops - switching from Fullscreen to Windowed or Borderless usually fixes this.
[/list]

Let us know what you think in the comments! We'll continue rolling out patches to improve approachability, but we're also planning to dive deeper into the logistics flow for late-game Cartels by reducing some of the more nuanced micro-management requirements. Stay tuned to our news for updates!

notes.title: Cartel Tycoon: build your drug empire!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=45_yFrItWx8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are Moon Moose, and we are developing a game that absolutely puts you in the shoes (err, Ferragamo loafers?) of a drug kingpin in the late ‘80s. This is a strategically rich tycoon simulator at its core with a heavy emphasis on narrative. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/a93ac0699cbb7e88c11153f7d324e5dbedd17fb1.png[/img]

You will…

- Build marijuana and coca farms
- Refine raw product into sellable goods at labs
- Choose trade routes
- Bribe authorities and defend against rival cartels
- Launder dirty money
- Expand your territory
- Disguise your goods with coffee, spices, and other legal trades
- Monitor and improve the efficiency of your business at all levels
- Enjoy the awesome OST with the psychedelic and Latin American influences

But inevitably, you will perish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/5cd5b4996c5d009ff6836a7e8a438b0befc3551e.gif[/img]


For us, Cartel Tycoon isn’t a chance to glorify what it’s like to rule a cartel and make millions of dollars. We’ve done our research. If profit is an equation, then violence and its sources are the variables. When wealth and power accumulate, those who already have these things in plentiful supply feel threatened. Rival gangs, international authorities, and the cartel itself all contribute to an unavoidable escalation of violence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/6e49cb09ff94f1334998894e1570046e286f4fd9.gif[/img]


When you die, one of your lieutenants will take over and the empire can rebuild. In this way, you’ll face off against procedurally generated threats and challenges for a different kingpin experience every time. But that cycle of violence, of growing and becoming too big to not fail, never goes away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/d5644405f9e0e5288de7f845a4198c750d0c839d.png[/img]

notes.title: Cartel Tycoon: build your drug empire!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=45_yFrItWx8;full][/previewyoutube]

We are Moon Moose, and we are developing a game that absolutely puts you in the shoes (err, Ferragamo loafers?) of a drug kingpin in the late ‘80s. This is a strategically rich tycoon simulator at its core with a heavy emphasis on narrative. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/a93ac0699cbb7e88c11153f7d324e5dbedd17fb1.png[/img]

You will…

- Build marijuana and coca farms
- Refine raw product into sellable goods at labs
- Choose trade routes
- Bribe authorities and defend against rival cartels
- Launder dirty money
- Expand your territory
- Disguise your goods with coffee, spices, and other legal trades
- Monitor and improve the efficiency of your business at all levels
- Enjoy the awesome OST with the psychedelic and Latin American influences

But inevitably, you will perish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/5cd5b4996c5d009ff6836a7e8a438b0befc3551e.gif[/img]


For us, Cartel Tycoon isn’t a chance to glorify what it’s like to rule a cartel and make millions of dollars. We’ve done our research. If profit is an equation, then violence and its sources are the variables. When wealth and power accumulate, those who already have these things in plentiful supply feel threatened. Rival gangs, international authorities, and the cartel itself all contribute to an unavoidable escalation of violence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/6e49cb09ff94f1334998894e1570046e286f4fd9.gif[/img]


When you die, one of your lieutenants will take over and the empire can rebuild. In this way, you’ll face off against procedurally generated threats and challenges for a different kingpin experience every time. But that cycle of violence, of growing and becoming too big to not fail, never goes away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/d5644405f9e0e5288de7f845a4198c750d0c839d.png[/img]
